# Which role uses which skill, and why

Generated by `python3 tools/check.py --write` from skills.json. "Why" is the skill's own description: it is when the bot loads it.

| Role | Skill | Where | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| lead | `bot-guards` | `guards/` | The checks every role runs in code before it drafts, sends or spends, and the heartbeat it writes at the end. Load on every run. |
